playbookOutputs: Confirmation of submission and acknowledgement from the registering body
playbookCommonFailures: The registering body has not been confirmed — the catalogue's 'NCCA' is ambiguous and the pack goes to the wrong place
COIDA Letter of Good Standing expired or not yet issued because the assessment is unpaid
Certified director IDs older than 3 months
Proof of business address older than 3 months or in a director's name
Nature-of-business description does not match the activity the body registers

informationToProvide.label: Certified copies of all directors'/members' ID documents - not older than 3 months
alternatives: Certified passport copy for a foreign director
informationToProvide.aiHint: Mandatory CIPC KYC Invariant: South African citizens MUST submit a certified SA ID (Smart ID Card front AND back, or Green Barcoded ID Book) certified within the last 3 months by a Commissioner of Oaths or SAPS — passports are NOT accepted for SA citizens. Foreign nationals ONLY may submit a certified/apostilled foreign passport accompanied by a valid visa/permit. Verify legible ID/passport number, full legal names, and certification stamp date within 90 days.

informationToProvide.label: Company registration documents (e.g., CIPC CoR14.3, CoR39)
alternatives: CK1 / CK2 for a close corporation
informationToProvide.aiHint: CIPC CoR14.3 and, where directors have changed, the latest CoR39. Registered name, enterprise number and directors must match the IDs supplied.

informationToProvide.label: Proof of business address (utility bill or lease agreement)
informationToProvide.aiHint: Utility bill, municipal account or signed lease in the company's name showing the physical business address, dated within 3 months.

informationToProvide.label: Details regarding the nature of your business activities requiring NCCA registration
informationToProvide.aiHint: Plain description of what the business does, for whom, and why NCCA registration is required (e.g. a tender, a client contract, a licence condition). Also ask which body the client understands 'NCCA' to be — this tells Kevin where the application goes.

informationToProvide.label: Completed NCCA-specific information forms (if applicable, provided by us)
informationToProvide.aiHint: The body's own application form completed and signed by a director, if we have supplied one. Check every mandatory field is filled and the signature is present.

informationToProvide.label: Letter of good standing from the Department of Labour for Compensation for Occupational Injuries and Diseases Act (COIDA)
informationToProvide.aiHint: Current Compensation Fund Letter of Good Standing in the company's name; check the expiry date printed on it is in the future. If none exists, offer COIDA Registration / Renewal first.

informationToProvide.label: Valid SARS Tax Compliance Status (TCS) PIN Letter
informationToProvide.aiHint: SARS Notice of Registration or Tax Compliance Status PIN letter for the company. The catalogue prerequisite is truncated at 'Proof' — ⚠ confirm with Kevin what proof is intended.

informationToProvide.label: Business Bank Confirmation Letter (In the Company Name, Not Older Than 3 Months)
informationToProvide.helpText: Upload an official bank confirmation letter (< 3 months) in the company name.
informationToProvide.aiHint: Official bank account confirmation letter from a registered SA bank in the company name, dated within 90 days.

informationToProvide.label: Proof of Public Liability Insurance Policy (Minimum R1,000,000 Cover, Not Older Than 3 Months)
informationToProvide.helpText: NCCA membership requires proof of active Public Liability Insurance with a minimum cover of R1 million.
informationToProvide.aiHint: Public Liability Insurance policy schedule or broker confirmation in the company name showing active cover of at least R1,000,000.

informationToProvide.label: Valid NBC Provident Fund Certificate / Bargaining Council Letter of Good Standing
informationToProvide.helpText: Upload your valid NBC Contract Cleaning National Provident Fund / BCCCI compliance certificate.
informationToProvide.aiHint: Valid compliance certificate or Letter of Good Standing from NBC Holdings / Contract Cleaning Provident Fund or Bargaining Council in the company name.

informationToProvide.label: Valid B-BBEE Certificate / Sworn Affidavit & Occupational Health and Safety (OHS) Appointment Letter
informationToProvide.helpText: Upload your valid B-BBEE Sworn Affidavit / Certificate and your internal OHS Section 16(2) / Safety Representative appointment letter.
informationToProvide.aiHint: Valid B-BBEE Certificate or Sworn Affidavit in the company name alongside the Occupational Health and Safety appointment letter.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Collect NCCA registration requirements from client
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Every required document uploaded, nature-of-business answered, COIDA Letter of Good Standing valid
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: This service registers a cleaning company with the National Contract Cleaners Association (NCCA — www.ncca.co.za). Chase any missing NCCA statutory requirements: CoR 14.3, certified director IDs (< 3 months), proof of business address, bank confirmation letter, SARS TCS PIN, COIDA Letter of Good Standing, NBC Provident Fund Certificate, Public Liability Insurance (min R1m), B-BBEE Certificate, and OHS appointment letter.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Verify documents against the body's requirements
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: All required uploads pass the rules engine or are approved by Kevin; COIDA letter unexpired
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: The applicant is the company, never the ordering contact. CoR14.3, proof of address and Letter of Good Standing in the company's name and agreeing on the registered name. Director names on CoR14.3 / CoR39 must match the certified IDs; certification within 90 days. Read the Letter of Good Standing expiry date and flag if it lapses within 30 days. Extract enterprise number, income tax number, physical address, directors and the business description.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Draft application pack: cover letter, POA and hand-off sheet
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Cover letter, POA and application field hand-off sheet posted for Kevin's review
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Cover letter on My Accountant letterhead addressed to the body Kevin confirms, listing the enclosed documents. Special POA authorising Kevin Freese (CIBA #3561) to lodge and follow up the application. Hand-off sheet mirroring the body's application form fields (⚠ verify the form once the body is known) filled from extracted facts; never invent a membership category, fee or activity code — leave blank and flag.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Send application form and POA to client for signature
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Signed application form and POA uploaded by client
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Post the approved drafts with plain instructions: a director signs where marked and returns as PDF. Ask for commissioner of oaths certification only where the body's form requires it.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Email application pack to the registering body
fulfillmentChecklist.expectedReply: Acknowledgement with an application reference and any fee invoice
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Submit the complete NCCA membership application dossier (signed NCCA application form, cover letter, POA, CoR 14.3, certified director IDs, proof of address, bank confirmation, SARS TCS PIN, COIDA Letter of Good Standing, NBC Provident Fund certificate, Public Liability Insurance >= R1m, B-BBEE certificate, and OHS letter) to the NCCA regional branch (info@ncca.co.za). Remind client that NCCA membership/inspection fees are payable directly to the NCCA.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Wait for the body's decision and follow up
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Registration certificate / number received, or a query from the body
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Draft a polite status-request email quoting the reference at each follow-up point. If the body raises a query, create a proposal for Kevin with the query text and the documents it concerns.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Deliver NCCA certificate and number to client
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Certificate and registration number posted to Communication History
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Post the certificate, note any renewal date printed on it and the need to keep the COIDA Letter of Good Standing current.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Final sign-off
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Kevin confirms the order can be completed
